```{.tikz}
\begin{tikzpicture}[very thick, line cap=round]
    \def\a{1}
    \def\r{0.15}
    \def\dx{0.3*\a}

    \foreach \x in {0,...,4}{
        \draw[mygrey] (\x*\a,\a) -- (\x*\a,3*\a);
        \fill[mygrey] (\x*\a,2*\a) circle (\r);
    }

    \foreach \x in {0,...,4}{
        \foreach \y in {0,3}{
            \draw[bound] (\x*\a,\y*\a) -- (\x*\a,{(\y+1)*\a});
        }
        \draw[bound] (\x*\a,\a) -- (\x*\a+\dx,2*\a);
        \draw[bound] (\x*\a+\dx,2*\a) -- (\x*\a,3*\a);
    }

    \foreach \x in {0,...,3}{
        \foreach \y in {0,1,3,4}{
            \draw[bound] (\x*\a,\y*\a) -- ({(\x+1)*\a},\y*\a);
        }
        \draw[bound] (\x*\a+\dx,2*\a) -- ({(\x+1)*\a+\dx},2*\a);
    }

    \foreach \x in {0,...,4}{
        \foreach \y in {0,1,3,4}{
            \fill[atom] (\x*\a,\y*\a) circle (\r);
        }
        \fill[atom] (\x*\a+\dx,2*\a) circle (\r);
    }

\end{tikzpicture}
```
